title: An aggregation in a FILTER predicate is not restricted to the current row

source.quote: because SUM computes the sum of all unit prices visible in the current filter context, the result is, for each product, the sum unit prices from the entire table
source.supports: an aggregation in a row context uses the filter context, so it covers the entire table

source.quote: Remember: the row context iterates, it does not filter.
source.supports: the row context of FILTER does not filter Product

derivation: AVERAGE ( Product[Price] ) is evaluated in the empty filter context on every row: (100 + 20 + 10 + 50) / 4 = 45. Product[Price] is the current row's price. Prices above 45: Bike (100) and Scooter (50), so 2 rows. If the average were of the current row only, no price would exceed itself and the count would be BLANK.
